selection.method: Source-only selection after Anthropic canonical 15/15. Four real Claude Agent SDK TypeScript applications and four Managed Agents applications (Python and TypeScript), pinned before any HorusTrace execution.

cases.source_signal: BaseAgent dynamically imports @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query(), then invokes it with inline options carrying cwd, additionalDirectories, project settings, MCP servers, permissionMode and the claude_code preset tool surface.

Desktop session host invokes Claude Agent SDK query through a repository-local SDK wrapper, supports runtime permission modes including bypass, canUseTool permission callbacks, MCP configuration and project/workspace scope.

Review/verify agents invoke query() with repository-local buildReviewOptions/buildHelperOptions, cwd, MCP/chrome options, max turns and structured outputs; tests cross-file options builders rather than direct literal options.
Planner/generator/evaluator use Claude Agent SDK query() with role-specific options and a security module implementing a Bash command allowlist hook; tests TypeScript control and options composition.

Creates a Claude Managed Agent with an MCP server, mcp_toolset permission policy and optional skill, then creates a cloud environment/session; agent definition is assembled with local variables and conditional composition.
Async evaluation harness creates/reuses Managed Agents and cloud environments with await client.beta.agents.create(), managed agent toolset configuration, sessions and event polling.

TypeScript Managed Agent create call spreads buildAgentParams() containing multiple operator-configured MCP endpoints and permission policies; tests repository-local TypeScript config-builder propagation.
Production-style TypeScript Managed Agents integration creates cloud environments, vault credentials, managed agents with built-in toolset/skills/MCP toolsets, and sessions carrying vault_ids.
